effects_provenance.raw: Karamel Kandy THCA Flower Preferred / 28g Strain Profile Karamel Kandy THCA Flower is a decadent hybrid that blends dessert-like sweetness with smooth, mellow effects. The cultivar produces dense, well-structured buds with a warm inviting aromatic profile featuring creamy caramel, toasted sugar, and vanilla layered with hints of nutmeg and spice. Effects Karamel Kandy delivers a balanced experience that pairs warm cerebral euphoria with comfortable body relaxation. The high feels well-rounded and pleasant — suitable for late-afternoon use, social settings, or evening flavor-led decompression — with the kind of dessert-rich character that distinguishes flavor-led hybrids. Flavor & Aroma On the palate: buttery caramel up front, with sweet candy sugar through the middle and a warm vanilla-spice finish on the exhale. Smoke is silky and unmistakably dessert-rich. The terpene profile reads caramel-and-vanilla — see the COA for the exact terpene breakdown of the current batch. Lab Tested — View the COA Every Karamel Kandy harvest is third-party tested for cannabinoid content, terpenes, residual solvents, pesticides, and heavy metals. Download the Karamel Kandy THCA Flower Certificate of Analysis for full test results. Tiers Explained Our three quality tiers are: Supreme — Hand-selected top-shelf buds with the densest structure, highest trichome coverage, and strongest terpene expression. Preferred — Premium-grade flower at a balanced price, using the same genetics and cultivation with a slightly broader bud selection. Essential — Our value tier, using the same strain and lab testing with smaller or more uniform buds. Federally Compliant Hemp Lit Farms Karamel Kandy THCA Flower is hemp-derived and federally compliant under the 2018 Farm Bill — containing less than 0.3% Δ9-THC by dry weight at harvest. Must be 21+ to purchase. Not for sale in jurisdictions where THCA flower is restricted. Explore our full THCA Flower collection for more strains.
